notes: GAAP city. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (p5); business-type lines from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position total column (p7). Business-type nonoperating loss on disposal (60), interest expense and bond issuance costs recorded as disbursements, so reported_totals business-type are computed. Governmental transfers out 39,879 matches business-type net transfers in 39,879 (Water -3,186, Sewer +18,065, Trash +25,000). Ending cash = cash and cash equivalents on governmental funds balance sheet (p4, 1,529,685; certificates of deposit 261,388 and county treasurer cash 11,404 shown separately). Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position, Total primary government column (p1). Detail: General Fund recorded from the more detailed General Fund Departments combining schedule (pp15-16, one line per department column); the General Fund budget schedule (p10) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Street and LB840 budget schedules (budgetary basis, differ from GAAP statement) and Lottery/CDBG nonmajor columns recorded. Cemetery department mapped to streets/highways and Medical Clinic to general government to tie to the statement's function lines (Public works 53,190 and General government 467,673). 'Salaries and benefits' recorded as salaries and wages (combined line). Enterprise fund per-fund (Water/Sewer/Trash) lines not repeated in detail.
